name: claudian
headline: Claudian: AI Collaboration in Obsidian
short_description: Claudian is an innovative Obsidian plugin that integrates Claude Code as an AI collaborator within your vault, enhancing productivity and coding efficiency. It uses advanced AI capabilities to assist users in their development workflows seamlessly.
author: YishenTu

sections.overview:
Claudian brings Claude AI capabilities directly into Obsidian as a native plugin, allowing you to leverage AI assistance without leaving your vault. The plugin integrates with Claude Code to support AI-assisted development and knowledge work within your note-taking environment. It supports multiple AI providers through a provider-neutral architecture, including Claude and Codex, with configurable thinking levels and effort settings to customize AI assistance intensity. Claudian enables inline editing, context-aware interactions, and vault-integrated workflows, making it suitable for developers and knowledge workers who want seamless AI collaboration alongside their documentation and code.
Integrate AI assistance in note-taking to enhance content generation and organization.
Automate repetitive coding tasks within Obsidian, saving time and reducing errors.
Enhance project management by utilizing AI collaboration for task tracking and updates.
Streamline documentation processes with AI-generated summaries and insights.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install YishenTu/claudian`
`git clone https://github.com/YishenTu/claudian`

Based on your description, it seems you're trying to automate note-taking from your Productiv financial reports. Here's a Python script you can run through Claudian to extract key data and create structured notes in your Obsidian vault:

```python
import requests
import json

# Productiv API endpoint
url = "https://api.productiv.com/reports/financial"

# Headers with your API key
headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}

# Make the API request
response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

# Parse the JSON response
data = json.loads(response.text)

# Process the data and create notes
for report in data['reports']:
    note_content = f"# {report['title']}\n\n## Key Metrics:\n- Revenue: {report['revenue']}\n- Expenses: {report['expenses']}\n- Profit: {report['profit']}\n\n## Analysis:\n{report['analysis']}"
    
    # Save the note to your Obsidian vault
    with open(f"vault/notes/{report['title']}.md", "w") as note_file:
        note_file.write(note_content)
```

To use this script:
1. Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual Productiv API key
2. Ensure your Obsidian vault path is correct
3. Run the script through Claudian
4. The notes will be created in your specified vault directory
